shared_elements: human or humanoid figure with arms/hands
justification: Both surfaces stack the same repertoire of motifs vertically — animals (including a quadruped with snout and limbs) placed above a human-like figure whose arms and hands are shown, plus serpentine/hatched incised elements — and in both the animal appears to dominate or overhang the human element, which is a fairly specific shared scheme. The biggest difference in depicted content is the mode of figuring: A presents flat profile creatures in registers across a rectangular field with a band of zigzag/net pattern separating them, while B presents a frontal, fully modelled human head being clasped, with no register bands and no profile animal frieze.
